name: Mercury
typeSystem: Static, strong Hindley-Milner-style types layered on pure logic programming, plus compiler-checked mode declarations (which arguments are inputs vs. outputs) and determinism declarations (how many solutions a predicate can have).
runtime: Compiles through C to native machine code by default, with a garbage-collected runtime that supports Prolog-style backtracking only where the mode system says it is actually needed.

runtimes.name: Native (C backend, Boehm GC)
runtimes.role: Default grade: compiles through C to native code, using the Boehm conservative garbage collector.

runtimes.name: Java grade
runtimes.role: Compiles to JVM bytecode for interoperation with Java libraries.

runtimes.name: C# grade
runtimes.role: Compiles to .NET IL for interoperation with C#.

compilers.name: mmc (Melbourne Mercury Compiler)
compilers.role: Reference compiler; supports multiple backend 'grades' (C, Java, C#) from the same source.

concurrencyModel: Explicit concurrency is available through Mercury threads and futures (spawn/wait). The language also has a parallel-conjunction operator (&); supporting .par grades may execute its conjuncts in parallel, with the exact implementation and availability depending on the selected backend and grade.

codeExample.caption: Hello, World!
codeExample.source:
:- module hello.
:- interface.
:- import_module io.
:- pred main(io::di, io::uo) is det.

:- implementation.

main(!IO) :-
    io.write_string("Hello, World!\n", !IO).
